title: Construction of locally constant integer cochains
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group in universe $u$, $\mathcal A$ an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and $E:\mathcal A\simeq\operatorname{DiscreteContinuousRep}_{\mathbb Z}(G)$ [def-exc-discrete-modules-category] with carrier universe $\max(u,s)$. There exist a functor $C:\mathcal A\to\operatorname{CochainComplex}(\operatorname{Ab}_{\max(u,s)},\mathbb N)$ and additive equivalences $e_{M,n}:C(M)^n\simeq\operatorname{LC}(G^n,E(M))$. Under these coordinates $C(f)^n$ is postcomposition with $E(f)$, and $d^nc(g)=g_0c(g_1,\ldots,g_n)+\sum_{k=0}^n(-1)^{k+1}c(\operatorname{contract}_k(g))$, where contract multiplies adjacent entries for $k<n$ and drops the last entry for $k=n$. Here LC denotes locally constant functions. This statement makes no assertion of additivity of C or preservation of short exact sequences.

proof.text: Construct lcD explicitly on locally constant functions using the displayed inhomogeneous differential. Open stabilizers give ContinuousSMul on the discrete coefficient module. The tail and contractNth maps are continuous coordinatewise, so each face and its finite signed sum are locally constant. Addition is verified pointwise.

Give the coefficient representation its discrete topology, making each linear action map continuous. Apply lem-sc-homogeneous-inhomogeneous-continuous-cohomology to obtain additive coordinates identifying lcD with the differential of Mathlib TopRep.homogeneousCochains. Transport the square-zero equation of that complex through these coordinates. No data is chosen from an unproved existence theorem: lcD remains the explicit formula, and the coordinates are used only in the proof of square-zero.

Build lcComplex with CochainComplex.of. Define coefficient maps by LocallyConstant.mapAddMonoidHom. Equivariance, map_add, map_sum and map_zsmul prove commutation with lcD pointwise. HomologicalComplex.hom_ext and pointwise reflexivity prove identity and composition. Compose the resulting functor with E.functor and take identity additive coordinates; the two required formulas are respectively reflexivity and CochainComplex.of_d.
